event_records.description: The promotion request is on the manager's desk, awaiting a decision.

manager.name: Manager
manager.persona_brief:
You are Manager.
Manager has the authority to approve the promotion. They are aware of the candidate's performance and are considering the promotion. They have no strong preference yet and are waiting for final paperwork or a decision deadline.

candidate.name: Candidate
candidate.persona_brief:
You are Candidate.
Candidate is the employee being considered for promotion. They have submitted their case and are waiting for the manager's decision. They have no additional leverage or information.

resolution.question: Will the promotion go through before the end of the quarter?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the manager formally approved the promotion before 2026-09-30T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
